title: Paul McCartney live: Fukuoka Dome, Fukuoka | 1993
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Fukuoka Dome in Fukuoka, Japan, on 18 November 1993.

It was the 68th night of the New World Tour, which lasted for 77 dates across 19 countries between February and December 1993, and the first of two consecutive nights in Fukuoka.

McCartney’s band was Linda McCartney on vocals, keyboards, and percussion; Hamish Stuart on guitar, bass guitar, and vocals; Robbie McIntosh on guitar and vocals; Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens on keyboards and vocals; and Blair Cunningham on drums and percussion.

McCartney returned to the Fukuoka Dome on 15 November 2013 during the Out There Tour.
